GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 13, 2025
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:00 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LILIA.ROMERO@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54680  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, December 5, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

2.  25-54681  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

3.  25-54683  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

4.  25-54684  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, recommend the Director approve
  the proposed Golf Fees and Charges schedule for 2025-2026 as endorsed by the
  Fees and Charges Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

5.  25-54685  Recommendation for Director to approve the proposed golf courses Food and
  Beverage price list and continue the temporary egg dishes price increase.

  Page 1 of 2
   GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 13, 2025
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

6.  25-54686  Recommendation to receive and file the 2025 Emergency On-Call List.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

7.  25-54687  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees, discuss
  anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate, take action to
  dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at 562.570.3104 or
Lilia.Romero@longbeach.gov
